resources.string: Hew rough stone and precious metals from the earth to raise the Temple.
Gather provisions at the markets and quays of Joppa, so the festive board lacks nothing.
Fell and square olive, acacia and cedar of Lebanon, as the carpenter-fellows did to frame the Temple and feed its lights.
Sow and harvest wheat, vines and olives: the corn, wine and oil of the lodge.
Burn logs from your inventory to kindle the Lights and gain Illumination XP. Each log burned also leaves ashes, which can be scattered through Reflection for bonus Reflection XP.
Practise the ritual journeys to shorten session times across all skills. Level 99 cuts %1$d minutes off the hour (60 min → %2$d min), with a smooth linear reduction as you level up.
Smelt ores into ingots and cast fine metal tools, as Hiram cast the pillars.
Prepare the festive board: fraternal fare and toasts that restore HP during Trials.
Craft quills and compose orations from logs and metal nibs.
Fashion office jewels and regalia from precious materials.
Trace symbols upon the rough ashlar to fuel your Wisdom.
Distil elixirs from garden herbs and trial reagents to strengthen you for the Trials. V.I.T.R.I.O.L.!
Sharpens the precision of your gavel, increasing your chance to strike true.
Increases the maximum force of each gavel blow.
Keeps you composed, reducing the damage your vices inflict.
Confront your adversaries from afar with a well-cut quill and a sharp oration.
Invoke the power of the symbols. Higher levels unlock stronger workings.
Your total vitality. Higher levels let you endure the Trials longer.
Meditate on bones gathered in the Trials to earn Reflection XP. Memento mori. Higher levels unlock stronger meditations in the Chamber of Reflection.
Leaving the Chamber of Reflection, the Seeker takes the first blindfolded steps toward the door of the Temple.
The first journey: a rough, noisy road strewn with obstacles, like the world of the profane.
The second journey: a smoother path, ending in a purification by water.
The third journey, made in silence, ending in a purification by fire.
The Apprentice circles the lodge with measured steps across the black and white squares. Mind where you tread.
The Fellowcraft\'s five journeys, each with its own tools. Only the most composed complete them without faltering.
Three, five and seven steps that test your poise at every turn.
At the top of the staircase, a demanding passage into the Middle Chamber, where the wages are paid.
The Master\'s journey from West to East, seeking the lost Master until a sprig of acacia marks the spot.
A great circle where every link must hold. It will push you to your limits.
A procession beneath the twelve signs, where only the most dedicated dare to tread.
A legendary procession beneath the starry vault, spoken of in whispers among the Brethren.
A labyrinth laid by the old builders, whose path seems to defy the laws of geometry.
A luminous path guided by the Blazing Star.
The ultimate ritual journey, in search of the Word that was lost.
A procession along the isle\'s wave-scarred beach. Rocks shift underfoot with the tide.
A rope-and-ledge circuit through the symbol-lit canopy of the Cedar Forest of Lebanon.
A climb across the smoking flanks of the Peak of Fury. The stone remembers being an altar.
A vertical route up the pressure-cracked walls of the Abyssal Depths. Few reach the Light at the top.
Dispatch trade caravans along routes for coins and XP. Higher levels improve buy and sell prices at the Steward\'s Shop and unlock exclusive Lodge of Commerce goods.
